label: KAN-5
text:
VIVO V70 App Login Fails with 'Remember Me' Checked, Resulting in 500 Error

When attempting to log in to the VIVO V70 mobile application with valid credentials and the 'Remember Me' checkbox selected, the application returns a 500 Internal Server Error. This issue does not occur when the 'Remember Me' checkbox is unselected. The expected behavior is successful login with 'Remember Me' functionality working as intended. Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open the VIVO V70 app. 2. Enter valid username and password. 3. Check the 'Remember Me' checkbox. 4. Click Submit/Login. Actual Result: 500 Internal Server Error. Expected Result: User should log in successfully with session persistence.

text:
# QA Process Guide

## Bug triage

Bugs are triaged every weekday at 10:00 IST. Severity is set by QA, priority by
the product owner. Any Critical bug blocks the release train until a fix or a
documented waiver from the engineering manager exists.

## Definition of done for a story

1. Acceptance criteria in the PRD verified.
2. Automated coverage added to the Seleniu

label: qa-process-guide.md (part 2)
text:
m or Playwright suite (smoke tag if
 the flow is revenue-critical).
3. Regression suite green on Jenkins.
4. RTM row updated linking requirement → test cases → build.

## Flaky test policy

A test that fails then passes on rerun twice within a week is labelled
`flaky-test` in JIRA, quarantined out of the smoke suite, and must be fixed or
deleted within two sprints.

label: checkout-flow-diagram.txt
text:
Lucid chart export: Checkout flow (v3)

[Cart] -> [Address step] -> [Payment step] -> [Review] -> [Place order]
Payment step branches:
 - Card valid -> gateway authorize -> success -> Review
 - Card declined (402) -> map decline code -> show specific validation message -> stay on Payment step
 - Gateway timeout (>8s) -> retry once -> if second timeout, show "payment unavailable" and preserve cart
Notes: decline-code mapping added after VWO-1001. All error paths must preserve cart contents.

# PRD: Password Reset (v1.2)

## FR-1 Request reset

A user may request a password reset from the login page by entering their
registered email. The system always shows the same confirmation message whether
or not the email exists (no account enumeration).

## FR-2 Reset link

The reset link is single-use, expire

label: prd-password-reset.md (part 2)
text:
s after 30 minutes, and is invalidated if a
newer link is issued.

## FR-3 New password rules

Minimum 12 characters, at least one number and one symbol; the previous 5
passwords may not be reused. On success all active sessions are revoked.

## NFR-1

The reset email must be dispatched within 60 seconds at p95.
